name: Marama Davidson
photo_credit: Supplied to policy.nz by the candidate/party

questionnaire_2026.Why I'm standing: In Aotearoa people care about each other and our environment. There is enough resource in Aotearoa for everyone to live with dignity, and to protect our environment. The Green Party has consistently put up solutions to ensure everyone has what they need to live good lives, and to ensure we leave a healthy, thriving planet behind for all of our mokopuna. I am standing to be an uncompromising voice for people and planet.
questionnaire_2026.About me: I have almost 11 years' experience as a Member of Parliament, nearly 9 years' experience as a co-leader, and 3 years' experience as a Minister of the Crown. Throughout that experience I have consistently stayed connected to the very people and communities on the front-lines of injustice. I have deep long-earned relationships across communities and groups who provide the expertise and the solutions that our communities deserve.
